---
title: "Overall survival — primary estimand"
subtitle: "182-day RMST, survival, and risk contrasts"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

For each completed dataset, 200 standardized posterior survival draws are
calculated on 200 time points through day 182. RMST uses the trapezoidal rule;
the 50 completed datasets are pooled with equal weight.

```{r}
#| label: derive-os-estimand
#| include: false

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "model-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "imputation.R"))
source(here::here("R", "survival-helpers.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$main$m)
model_dir <- here::here("artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "models")
imputation_path <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "imputations.rds"
)
estimand_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "estimand"
)
result_dir <- here::here("results", "primary", "overall-survival")
figure_dir <- here::here("artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "figures")
dir.create(estimand_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
imputations <- readRDS(imputation_path)

for (index in indices) {
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  curves_path <- file.path(
    estimand_dir,
    sprintf("survival-curves-%02d.parquet", index)
  )
  rmst_path <- file.path(estimand_dir, sprintf("rmst-draws-%02d.parquet", index))
  risk_path <- file.path(estimand_dir, sprintf("risk-draws-%02d.parquet", index))
  if (!force && all(file.exists(c(curves_path, rmst_path, risk_path)))) next

  model <- readRDS(model_path)
  data <- mice::complete(imputations, index)
  data$mgps <- factor(data$mgps, levels = 0:2)
  curve_list <- vector("list", 2L)
  # Reuse one seed so treatment and control select identical posterior draws.
  prediction_seed <- analysis_seed(config, "survival", index)

  for (treatment in 0:1) {
    newdata <- data
    newdata$tx <- treatment
    raw_curves <- rstanarm::posterior_survfit(
      model,
      newdata = newdata,
      times = 0,
      extrapolate = TRUE,
      standardise = TRUE,
      control = list(
        edist = config$analysis$horizon_days,
        epoints = 200L
      ),
      return_matrix = TRUE,
      draws = config$markov$post_estimation_draws,
      seed = prediction_seed
    )
    curve_matrix <- if (is.matrix(raw_curves)) raw_curves else
      do.call(cbind, raw_curves)
    curve_matrix <- as.matrix(curve_matrix)
    times <- if (is.list(raw_curves)) {
      vapply(raw_curves, function(curve) {
        curve_time <- attr(curve, "times")
        if (length(curve_time) != 1L || !is.finite(curve_time)) {
          stop("Each standardized survival curve must contain one time point.")
        }
        as.numeric(curve_time)
      }, numeric(1))
    } else {
      attr(raw_curves, "times")
    }
    if (is.null(times)) {
      times <- seq(
        0,
        config$analysis$horizon_days,
        length.out = ncol(curve_matrix)
      )
    }
    if (nrow(curve_matrix) < config$markov$post_estimation_draws &&
        ncol(curve_matrix) == config$markov$post_estimation_draws) {
      curve_matrix <- t(curve_matrix)
    }
    if (length(times) != ncol(curve_matrix)) {
      stop("Survival-curve time points do not match the posterior matrix.")
    }
    curve_matrix <- curve_matrix[
      seq_len(config$markov$post_estimation_draws),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
    curve_list[[treatment + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      draw = rep(
        seq_len(config$markov$post_estimation_draws),
        each = length(times)
      ),
      time = rep(times, times = config$markov$post_estimation_draws),
      survival = as.vector(t(curve_matrix)),
      tx = treatment,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  curves <- do.call(rbind, curve_list)
  curves$imputation <- index
  rmst <- compute_rmst_draws(
    curves,
    draw_col = "draw",
    time_col = "time",
    survival_col = "survival",
    horizon = config$analysis$horizon_days,
    group_cols = c("tx", "imputation")
  )
  risk <- survival_risk_draws(
    curves,
    horizon = config$analysis$horizon_days,
    treatment_col = "tx"
  )
  risk$imputation <- index

  arrow::write_parquet(curves, curves_path, compression = "zstd")
  arrow::write_parquet(rmst, rmst_path, compression = "zstd")
  arrow::write_parquet(risk, risk_path, compression = "zstd")
}

pooled_outputs <- file.path(
  result_dir,
  c(
    "rmst-summary.parquet",
    "risk-summary.parquet",
    "estimand-draws.parquet",
    "survival-curves.parquet",
    "follow-up-sufficiency.yml"
  )
)
if (force || any(!file.exists(pooled_outputs))) {
rmst_frames <- lapply(indices, function(index) {
  frame <- arrow::read_parquet(file.path(
    estimand_dir,
    sprintf("rmst-draws-%02d.parquet", index)
  )) |>
    as.data.frame()
  control <- frame[frame$tx == 0, c("draw", "imputation", "rmst")]
  intervention <- frame[frame$tx == 1, c("draw", "imputation", "rmst")]
  names(control)[[3L]] <- "rmst_0"
  names(intervention)[[3L]] <- "rmst_1"
  joined <- merge(control, intervention, by = c("draw", "imputation"))
  if (nrow(joined) != config$markov$post_estimation_draws) {
    stop("Treatment and control RMST draws could not be matched.")
  }
  joined$rmst_diff <- joined$rmst_1 - joined$rmst_0
  joined
})
pooled_rmst <- do.call(rbind, rmst_frames)
rownames(pooled_rmst) <- NULL
rmst_summary <- summarize_posterior_draws(pooled_rmst$rmst_diff)
rmst_summary$probability_benefit <- posterior_probability(pooled_rmst$rmst_diff)
rmst_summary$ci_66_low <- quantile(pooled_rmst$rmst_diff, 0.17, names = FALSE)
rmst_summary$ci_66_high <- quantile(pooled_rmst$rmst_diff, 0.83, names = FALSE)
rmst_summary$ci_95_low <- quantile(pooled_rmst$rmst_diff, 0.025, names = FALSE)
rmst_summary$ci_95_high <- quantile(pooled_rmst$rmst_diff, 0.975, names = FALSE)
rmst_summary$rope_low <- -7
rmst_summary$rope_high <- 7
rmst_summary$rope_66_contains <- rmst_summary$ci_66_low >= -7 &&
  rmst_summary$ci_66_high <= 7
rmst_summary$horizon_days <- config$analysis$horizon_days

risk_frames <- lapply(indices, function(index) {
  frame <- arrow::read_parquet(file.path(
    estimand_dir,
    sprintf("risk-draws-%02d.parquet", index)
  )) |>
    as.data.frame()
  control <- frame[frame$tx == 0, c("draw", "imputation", "survival")]
  intervention <- frame[frame$tx == 1, c("draw", "imputation", "survival")]
  names(control)[[3L]] <- "survival_0"
  names(intervention)[[3L]] <- "survival_1"
  joined <- merge(control, intervention, by = c("draw", "imputation"))
  if (nrow(joined) != config$markov$post_estimation_draws) {
    stop("Treatment and control survival draws could not be matched.")
  }
  joined$risk_difference <- joined$survival_1 - joined$survival_0
  joined$risk_ratio <- joined$survival_1 / joined$survival_0
  joined
})
pooled_risks <- do.call(rbind, risk_frames)
risk_summary <- rbind(
  risk_difference = summarize_posterior_draws(pooled_risks$risk_difference),
  risk_ratio = summarize_posterior_draws(
    pooled_risks$risk_ratio[is.finite(pooled_risks$risk_ratio)]
  )
)
names(risk_summary)[4:6] <- c("q025", "q50", "q975")
risk_table <- data.frame(
  measure = c("survival_risk_difference", "survival_risk_ratio"),
  mean = risk_summary[c("risk_difference", "risk_ratio"), "mean"],
  median = risk_summary[c("risk_difference", "risk_ratio"), "median"],
  q025 = risk_summary[c("risk_difference", "risk_ratio"), "q025"],
  q975 = risk_summary[c("risk_difference", "risk_ratio"), "q975"],
  horizon_days = config$analysis$horizon_days,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

curve_frames <- lapply(indices, function(index) {
  arrow::read_parquet(file.path(
    estimand_dir,
    sprintf("survival-curves-%02d.parquet", index)
  )) |>
    as.data.frame()
})
pooled_curves <- do.call(rbind, curve_frames)
max_curve_day <- max(pooled_curves$time, na.rm = TRUE)
follow_up_sufficiency <- data.frame(
  horizon_days = c(182L, 365L),
  sufficient = c(max_curve_day >= 182, max_curve_day >= 365),
  reason = c(
    if (max_curve_day >= 182) "Primary OS curves cover 182 days."
    else "Primary OS curves do not cover 182 days.",
    if (max_curve_day >= 365) "OS curves cover 365 days."
    else "The primary OS curves stop before 365 days."
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

arrow::write_parquet(
  as.data.frame(rmst_summary),
  file.path(result_dir, "rmst-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
arrow::write_parquet(
  risk_table,
  file.path(result_dir, "risk-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
arrow::write_parquet(
  pooled_rmst,
  file.path(result_dir, "estimand-draws.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
arrow::write_parquet(
  pooled_curves,
  file.path(result_dir, "survival-curves.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
writeLines(
  yaml::as.yaml(follow_up_sufficiency),
  file.path(result_dir, "follow-up-sufficiency.yml")
)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: build-os-rmst-posterior-plot
#| include: false

rmst_plot_draws <- arrow::read_parquet(file.path(
  result_dir,
  "estimand-draws.parquet"
)) |>
  as.data.frame()

rmst_posterior_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  rmst_plot_draws,
  ggplot2::aes(x = rmst_diff)
) +
  ggdist::stat_dots(side = "bottom") +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(
    .width = c(0.66, 0.95),
    point_interval = ggdist::median_qi
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40"
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = paste0(
      "Difference in ", config$analysis$horizon_days,
      "-day restricted mean survival time (intervention - control), days"
    ),
    y = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "os-rmst-difference-posterior.png"),
  rmst_posterior_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```
